verdict.rationale: Algolia offers some background automation for data ingestion: the dashboard lets Algolia keep 'the schedule, the retries, and the transformations' without deploying code [docs-48]. The Crawler extracts web content into records [docs-12], and the CLI supports scripts and CI workflows [docs-2]. Agent Studio is aimed at conversational assistants, not autonomous background jobs, so the evidence covers scheduled data syncs rather than general agentic automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose autonomous or agent-driven background automations, triggers and event-based workflows beyond data ingestion, detailed scheduling docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
